name: Agent Simulation and Search Planning Pipeline Template
summary: Reusable base CDG for game, route, scheduling, logistics, robot, puzzle, and constrained planning competitions that combine state encoding, simulator rollouts, heuristic search, MCTS/backtracking MCTS, PPO/self-play policy guidance, pathfinding, parallelized C++ path optimization, spatial-control features, and rule-based orchestration.
dejargonized_summary: Represent the environment state, generate candidate actions, simulate or search future outcomes with methods such as MCTS, backtracking MCTS, A*, PPO rollouts, self-play, or parallelized path optimization, score candidates with heuristics or learned policies, repair constraints, and choose a valid plan.

inputs.name: environment_state
inputs.constraints: Game state, route graph, schedule, robot state, or constraint instance.

outputs.name: planned_actions
outputs.constraints: Actions, route, schedule, or optimized plan.

use_when: The solution must output actions, routes, schedules, decisions, or plans under hard constraints.

Winning solutions use simulation, rollout, local search, hill climbing, IDA*, beam search, MCTS, backtracking MCTS, A*, PPO, self-play, policy/value guidance, Voronoi space control, pathfinding, parallelized C++ path optimization, path merging, or rule-based orchestration.
do_not_use_when: The benchmark asks only for independent labels or continuous predictions with no coupled plan constraints.
The solution is a simple postprocessing heuristic on model predictions rather than a search, simulation, route, schedule, or action-planning loop.
applicability.key_insight: The durable topology is state to candidate actions to search/simulation to constraint-checked plan selection.

swappable_stages.candidate_generator: Can use heuristic rules, A* pathfinding, resource logistics, Voronoi/tessellation space-control features, path partitions, or learned policy proposals.
swappable_stages.search_or_rollout: Can be local search, simulated annealing, IDA*, beam search, MCTS, backtracking MCTS, PPO rollout, self-play policy evaluation, parallelized path merging, C++ route optimization, or simulator rollout.

applicability.scaling_notes: Cache state transitions and keep feasibility checks cheap enough to run inside search loops.
failure_modes: A strong scorer cannot recover if candidate generation misses feasible high-value actions.
Search can exploit simulator bugs or invalid constraint handling.

planning_constraints.subject: state_before_candidate_generation
planning_constraints.statement: Encode the full planning state and constraints before generating candidate actions, routes, schedules, or edits.
planning_constraints.rationale: Candidate generation is only meaningful when it can inspect resources, rules, and feasibility constraints.

planning_constraints.subject: constraint_check_after_search
planning_constraints.statement: Run feasibility repair or constraint checking after search or rollout and before selecting the final plan.
planning_constraints.rationale: Search and simulation can propose high-scoring candidates that are invalid under hard benchmark rules.

audit.rationale: Added after expansion validation left repeated unmatched planning, game, routing, and simulation solutions where state, candidate generation, search, and repair form a distinct topology.
audit.dejargonized_summary: This covers competitions that output valid actions or plans rather than independent predictions.
uncertainty_notes: Specific search methods such as MCTS, IDA*, simulated annealing, and beam search should remain refinements unless the topology changes.

references.title: Sciona expansion support-3 validation audit
references.note: Local deterministic and semantic audit of unmatched solution patterns.

stages.name: State Encoder
stages.description: Encode board, route, graph, robot, schedule, or environment state with all constraints and resources.
stages.dejargonized_description: Turn the current planning problem into a structured state representation.

stages.name: Candidate Generator
stages.description: Generate candidate moves, routes, schedules, questions, guesses, resource assignments, Voronoi-controlled regions, A* paths, or control actions from the encoded state.
stages.dejargonized_description: List plausible actions or plan edits to evaluate.
guarantees: Candidate actions can be scored or simulated.

stages.name: Search or Rollout
stages.description: Run local search, simulated annealing, IDA*, beam search, dynamic programming, MCTS, backtracking MCTS, PPO policy rollout, self-play policy/value evaluation, parallelized C++ path optimization, path merging, or simulator evaluation.
stages.dejargonized_description: Explore candidate outcomes before choosing the final plan.
preconditions: Simulator or scoring heuristic is available.
guarantees: Candidates are ranked by expected objective value or feasibility.

stages.name: Constraint Repair
stages.description: Repair infeasible actions, enforce path or resource constraints, and remove invalid candidates.
stages.dejargonized_description: Make sure candidate plans obey the rules.

stages.name: Plan Selection
stages.description: Choose the best valid action, route, schedule, or plan and format it for submission.
stages.dejargonized_description: Select and submit the best feasible plan.
preconditions: At least one feasible candidate exists.
guarantees: Final output satisfies the benchmark format.
